up: Return the compound ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds that have been tested in assays against the human nuclear receptor ROR-γ (CHEMBL1741186) where the assay organism is 'Homo sapiens'.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN activities a ON md.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741186' AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
